description.value: Over a long rest, using biotech's implements, you install cybernetic augmentations into your own body. As long as you have at least one augmentation installed, your body itself counts as a tech focus for your tech powers. You have 4 modification slots, gaining more at higher levels per the engineer table's Modification Slots column. Each augmentation beyond your proficiency bonus reduces your tech point maximum by 1. During a long rest you may install, swap, or remove augmentations up to your Intelligence modifier (minimum one), and any effect requiring a save uses your tech save DC.
